<!-- pr-reviewer: 4958b5f51f5f77b5c0f0be5c74f1321f51c6b645 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The one item from the review at 9135ccbb is addressed at this head. The `needs-rework` label was set by NeoTech, so it is left for NeoTech to drop.

**NeoTech's requested item, re-checked at 4958b5f5**
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 51; `upstream/main` is at 50, so this is main + 1. The matching line in `docs/decisions/731-mcp-setup-moves.md` says 51. The `camcraft-mcp` skill rows are in the diff, so the bump is required and present.

**What looks good**
- `set_operation_setup` and `delete_setup` build the existing `SetOperationSetup::new` / `DeleteSetup::new` (validation at command creation) and run them through `env.history.execute`, so each is one undo step (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:101-123`). No unwrap/expect/panic added. `setup` is required, so an omitted value is refused rather than read as "first position".
- Undo of `DeleteSetup` restores the setup's place in the order. `mcp_setup_moves` asserts the order directly (no `sort()`), and the command-level pin `setup_delete_order` (#1362/#1364) posts before and after undo and compares the program text; the MCP tool runs the same command, so the byte-identical restore holds over MCP. (The MCP test itself checks order and operation membership, not posted bytes; that is covered one layer down.)
- Refusals are the commands' own text and leave the document unchanged (second pin).
- Decision file present, skill rows added, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #731` present, no snapshot PNGs, no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes, no CHANGELOG.md edits.

**Local results** (PR head; trial merge with `upstream/main` 440a6b8d was "already up to date"; sccache on)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (app lib + 4 suites) | ok |
| app lib | 167 passed |
| `mcp_setup` | 9 passed |
| `mcp_setup_mount_trace` | 3 passed |
| `mcp_setup_moves` (the pin) | 2 passed |
| `mcp_wire_contour` | 4 passed |
| `setup_delete_order` (extra) | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs` is 414 lines (378 on main). AGENTS.md sets "~400 lines" and says to flag growth, not block; the PR crosses the line only by combining with main's `set_program`. A follow-up split along the setup-placement / program-info seam would be welcome.
- `status` lookup in `set_operation_setup` matches by key or label; fine for now.
- `mergeable` reads `MERGEABLE`, so the stale `conflicts` label is removed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
